(a) You might enjoy seeing a live show downtown this weekend—there’s a play running at the local theatre that’s been getting strong reviews. You could grab a drink afterward at a nearby lounge to round off the evening.
(b) You might enjoy checking out one of Vancouver’s new fusion restaurants—there’s a spot in Gastown blending South Asian spices with Pacific Northwest seafood that’s getting excellent reviews. It could be a great opportunity to explore an inventive menu and make an evening of it by walking along the waterfront afterward.
(c) You might enjoy catching a live cricket screening at a sports bar that caters to international games—there’s one on Cambie Street that’s known for big screens and a lively crowd. You could make an evening of it by sharing some bar snacks and reconnecting with the energy of the sport.
(d) You might enjoy checking out a local escape room challenge—there’s a highly rated one downtown with tech-driven puzzles that could appeal to your analytical side. You could wrap up the evening with a coffee at a nearby café and discuss the clues you cracked.
